fields.subject: SqlParameterCollectionExtensions
fields.trigger: a caller invokes a table-valued helper with SqlDataRecord rows, models, keyed models, or virtual compound keys containing a shard identifier
fields.response: append one Structured input parameter whose row values follow the supplied sequence and whose keyed overloads place the shard identifier before record and successive child identifiers
fields.postcondition: the parameter name is @-prefixed and the supplied collection is returned
